intro: Albania is a parliamentary republic, a NATO member and a candidate to join the European Union.

chapters.title: Parliament and prime minister
text: The 140-member parliament chooses the prime minister; Edi Rama, a former artist and mayor of Tirana, has led the government since 2013. In 2025 Albania made headlines by appointing an AI-generated virtual 'minister' to oversee public contracts.

chapters.title: Symbols
text: The red flag shows a black double-headed eagle, said to come from Skanderbeg's banner.
